findPage.description: 覆盖默认分页：加一个可选状态过滤
sql: SELECT id, user_name, age, balance, status
AND (#1 IS NULL OR status = #1)   -- [1] string status 可选状态

search.description: 复杂查询：关键字模糊匹配 + 分页
sql: SELECT id, user_name, age, balance, status
AND (#1 IS NULL OR user_name LIKE #1)   -- [1] string keyword 关键字，如 %张%
AND (#2 IS NULL OR age >= #2)           -- [2] int    minAge   最小年龄

countByStatus.description: 聚合统计：GROUP BY 无法自动推导 count，显式给出 countSql

pagination.countSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT status FROM t_user GROUP BY status) t
